scenario: Amazon 2026-06-23 Course Schedule：我刚讲完「建邻接表 + 入度数组，入度 0 全部入队，出队再给邻居减度」，面试官问「你这个拓扑排序用的是哪种遍历？」
scenario_en: Amazon, June 23, Course Schedule: right after I described building an adjacency list plus an in-degree array, seeding a queue with every in-degree-zero node and decrementing neighbours, the interviewer asked which traversal my topological sort used.
q: 入度数组 + 队列的 Kahn 算法，该报成 BFS 还是 DFS？
q_en: In-degree array plus a queue — do I call Kahn's algorithm BFS or DFS?
options: DFS：沿一条先修链一路钻到最深，回头再换分支
两者都不是：拓扑排序是贪心排序，不算图遍历
BFS：队列按层剥掉入度 0 的节点，逐层扩展
看容器：用 deque 算 BFS，用 list 算 DFS
options_en: DFS: dive down one prerequisite chain to the deepest node, then back up and try another branch.
Neither: topological sort is a greedy ordering, not really a graph traversal.
BFS: a queue peels off the in-degree-zero nodes layer by layer.
It depends on the container — a deque makes it BFS, a plain list makes it DFS.
tradeoff: BFS vs DFS：Kahn 用队列换来「层」这个语义，代价是拿不到 DFS post-order 那种子树结构。
why: 队列 + 一层层处理 = BFS；递归或栈 + 先走到最深 = DFS。Kahn 靠入度和队列驱动，形状就是 BFS。
why_en: Kahn's algorithm runs off an in-degree array and a queue, so it is BFS — queue and layers mean BFS, recursion and depth-first mean DFS.
whenOtherWins: 改用递归 + visited/递归栈、把 post-order 反过来输出，那才是 DFS 版拓扑排序，此时报 DFS 才对。
optionMeanings: DFS 的形状：递归或显式栈，一条路走到底。
把拓扑排序当成独立算法族，不归入遍历。
Kahn 的形状：入度 0 入队，逐层剥离。
把命名寄托在容器的具体写法上。
optionMeanings_en: The DFS shape: recursion or an explicit stack, one branch to the bottom.
Treats topological sort as its own family, outside traversal.
The Kahn shape: in-degree zero enqueued, peeled level by level.
Pins the name on which container you happened to use.
optionDirectness: 描述的是 DFS 版拓扑排序，不是入度法。
错在分类层：拓扑序确实由一次遍历产出。
抓住了「队列 + 层」这条判别线。
错在依据：deque 也能当栈，容器不定名。
optionDirectness_en: Describes the DFS variant of topological sort, not the in-degree method.
Wrong at the taxonomy level: the ordering does come out of one traversal.
Catches the real discriminator — queue plus layers.
Wrong basis: a deque can also act as a stack, so the container names nothing.
optionScenarioImpacts: 我当天就是这么答的，被追问两次仍没改口。
回避了面试官真正想听的那个分类。
一句话报对名，不用再听 Are you sure。
把话题带去 API 细节，名字仍然没定。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: That is exactly what I said on the day, and I kept it after two nudges.
Dodges the classification the interviewer was actually probing.
Names it right in one line, so no second 'are you sure'.
Drags the talk into API detail while the name stays unsettled.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用入度数组加队列做拓扑排序的算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kahn's algorithm topologically sorts a directed acyclic graph using an in-degree array and a queue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 广度优先搜索：用队列一层层向外扩展。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Breadth-first search explores a graph layer by layer using a queue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深度优先搜索：递归或栈先走到最深再回溯。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Depth-first search goes as deep as it can along one branch before backtracking.

scenario: 同一个术语我翻过两次车：Amazon 6/23 把 Kahn 叫成 DFS，Amazon Round 4 又给 BFS 编了个错理由。需要一句随时能背出来的判别。
scenario_en: I have missed this label twice: I called Kahn's algorithm DFS in the June 23 Amazon round, and gave BFS a wrong justification in onsite Round 4. I need a one-line test I can recite.
q: 被问「你用的是哪种遍历」时，用哪一句当场判别 BFS 和 DFS？
q_en: What one-line test tells BFS from DFS when the interviewer asks which traversal I used?
text: 判别一句话：队列 + 一层层处理 = {{BFS}}；递归或栈 + 先走到最深 = {{DFS}}。所以入度 + 队列的 Kahn 算法属于 {{BFS}}。
text_en: The one-liner: queue plus level-by-level means {{BFS}}; recursion or a stack going deepest-first means {{DFS}}. So Kahn's in-degree-and-queue algorithm is {{BFS}}.
why: 判别靠的是「用什么容器推进 + 展开顺序」，不是题目名字。背成一句话，被追问时不用现场推。
why_en: The test is what container drives the frontier and in what order it expands, not what the problem happens to be called.

scenario: 面试官追问：「除了你写的入度法，拓扑排序还能怎么写？两者有什么不一样？」我需要说清 DFS 版的辅助状态和输出顺序。
scenario_en: Follow-up: besides the in-degree method you wrote, how else can topological sort be done, and how do the two differ? I need the DFS variant's bookkeeping and output order.
q: Kahn 版和 DFS 版拓扑排序，最主要的差别在哪一项？
q_en: What is the main difference between the Kahn version and the DFS version of topological sort?
options: DFS 版能处理有环图，Kahn 版必须先保证无环
辅助状态与出序：Kahn 用入度计数，DFS 反转 post-order
DFS 版是 O(n log n)，Kahn 版是 O(n + m)，量级不同
Kahn 版只能判断能否完成，拿不到具体的课程顺序
options_en: The DFS version works on cyclic graphs while Kahn's needs an acyclic graph up front.
Bookkeeping and output order: Kahn counts in-degrees, DFS reverses its post-order.
The DFS version is O of n log n while Kahn is O of n plus m, so the orders differ.
Kahn's version only answers yes-or-no and cannot produce the actual course order.
tradeoff: Kahn vs DFS：Kahn 的出队顺序直接就是拓扑序，DFS 省掉入度数组，代价是要反转 post-order 并盯递归深度。
why: 两版时间空间都是 O(n + m)，真正的差别是辅助状态（入度数组 vs 递归栈）和出序方式（出队序 vs 反转 post-order）。
why_en: Both run in O of n plus m; what really differs is the bookkeeping — an in-degree array versus a recursion stack — and how the order falls out.
optionMeanings: 认为两版对环的容忍度不同。
把差别定位在状态与出序两处。
认为 DFS 版多了一次排序开销。
认为入度法只能做可行性判定。
optionMeanings_en: Claims the two variants tolerate cycles differently.
Locates the difference in bookkeeping and output order.
Claims the DFS variant pays an extra sorting cost.
Claims the in-degree method only decides feasibility.
optionDirectness: 错在能力边界：两版都靠自己检测环。
抓住了实现层真正分叉的两处。
错在复杂度：DFS 版没有排序步骤。
错在输出：LC 210 就是用 Kahn 返回顺序。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong about capability: both variants detect the cycle themselves.
Pins the two places where the implementations actually fork.
Wrong on complexity: the DFS variant sorts nothing.
Wrong on output: LeetCode 210 returns the order with Kahn's.
optionScenarioImpacts: 会被追问「那 Kahn 怎么发现环」而卡住。
能顺势报出两版量级相同这句加分话。
复杂度说错，比叫错名字扣得更多。
把自己写过的解讲小了，白丢一个加分点。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Invites 'then how does Kahn find a cycle' and stalls me.
Lets me add the bonus line that both variants share one bound.
A wrong complexity costs more than a wrong label.
Undersells the solution I actually wrote and drops a point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 后序：DFS 中一个节点的所有后继都处理完之后才记录它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Post-order records a node only after all of its descendants have been finished in a depth-first search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 回边：DFS 里指向当前递归栈中某个节点的边，出现即有环。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A back edge points to a node still on the recursion stack, which means the graph has a cycle.

scenario: 面试官说「你用 DFS 写一遍拓扑排序」。我要在递归里同时完成两件事：检测环、产出拓扑序。
scenario_en: The interviewer says: now write the topological sort with DFS. Inside the recursion I have to do two things at once, detect the cycle and produce the ordering.
q: DFS 版拓扑排序里，靠什么状态判定有环？
q_en: In the DFS version of topological sort, which piece of state proves there is a cycle?
options: 碰到已经被 visited 标记过的任意节点，就说明有环
递归深度超过节点总数 n 时判定有环
碰到仍在递归栈上的节点，也就是三色法里的灰色
回溯结束后拓扑序长度小于 n，说明有环
options_en: Hitting any node already marked visited means there is a cycle.
A recursion depth greater than the node count n means there is a cycle.
Hitting a node still on the recursion stack, the grey colour in the three-colour scheme.
After backtracking, an ordering shorter than n means there is a cycle.
tradeoff: 单个 visited vs 加递归栈：只用 visited 省一个数组，代价是把「已完成」和「正在访问」混成一类，环就查不出来。
why: DFS 要区分两种「见过」：已完成可以直接跳过，仍在栈上才是回边即有环。只用一个 visited 会把交叉边误判成环。
why_en: Depth-first search must separate finished nodes from nodes still on the recursion stack, because only an edge back into the stack is a real cycle.
whenOtherWins: 如果我写的是 Kahn 版，就没有递归栈可看，那时的环判据才是「出队计数小于 n」。
optionMeanings: 只用一个 visited 集合区分见过与没见过。
拿递归深度当环的信号。
三色法：白未访、灰在栈上、黑已完成。
用最终序列长度反推是否有环。
optionMeanings_en: Uses a single visited set to split seen from unseen.
Treats recursion depth as the cycle signal.
Three colours: white unvisited, grey on the stack, black finished.
Infers the cycle from the length of the final ordering.
optionDirectness: 错在粒度：交叉边也指向 visited，会误报环。
错在信号：链长 n 也能压满深度，却不是环。
灰色等于祖先节点，指向它的边就是回边。
这是 Kahn 的判据，DFS 里当不上主判据。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong granularity: a cross edge also points at a visited node and would false-alarm.
Wrong signal: a chain of n nodes fills the same depth without being a cycle.
Grey means an ancestor, so an edge into it is a back edge.
That is Kahn's test; in DFS it cannot be the primary check.
optionScenarioImpacts: 在菱形依赖的图上会当场报出不存在的环。
深链的合法输入被判成不可完成。
同一趟递归里既判环又攒出待反转的序列。
方向对但用错版本，面试官会继续追问。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It would report a phantom cycle on a diamond-shaped dependency graph.
A legal long chain gets rejected as unfinishable.
One pass both detects the cycle and builds the sequence to reverse.
Right instinct, wrong variant, so the follow-up keeps coming.

termDefinitions.meaning: 三色法：白=未访问、灰=在递归栈上、黑=已完成，用来区分回边和交叉边。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The three-colour scheme marks nodes white when unvisited, grey while on the recursion stack, and black once finished.

termDefinitions.meaning: 交叉边：指向另一棵已完成子树的边，不构成环。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross edge points into an already finished subtree and does not create a cycle.

scenario: Amazon 6/23：算法我讲对了，但把口头思路翻成代码时卡了约 5 分钟，面试官问「Are you stuck?」——卡点就是建邻接表和入度数组这两行。
scenario_en: Amazon, June 23: my verbal plan was right, but turning it into code took about five minutes and the interviewer asked if I was stuck. The blocker was the adjacency list and in-degree array lines.
q: Kahn 模板里，遍历 prerequisites 的那一行该同时更新哪两个结构？
q_en: In the Kahn template, which two structures does the single pass over prerequisites update?
options: 邻接表记 pre → course，同时给 course 的入度加一
邻接表记 course → pre，同时给 course 的入度加一
邻接表记 pre → course，同时给 pre 的入度加一
只建邻接表，入度等到 BFS 出队时再现算
options_en: The adjacency list stores pre to course, and course's in-degree goes up by one.
The adjacency list stores course to pre, and course's in-degree goes up by one.
The adjacency list stores pre to course, and pre's in-degree goes up by one.
Build only the adjacency list and compute in-degrees later during the BFS.
tradeoff: 顺依赖建边 vs 反向建边：顺着建让入度等于未满足的先修数，代价是边方向和输入元组正好相反，写的时候要停一秒对齐。
why: 边要顺着「先修 → 后修」，入度才等于「还欠多少门先修」；入度加在被指向的那门课上，一趟循环两件事同时做完。
why_en: Point each edge from prerequisite to course so a node's in-degree counts the prerequisites it still owes, and bump the in-degree of the node the edge points at.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目给的是「course → 它的先修列表」并要求反向输出，那就该建反向边，入度加在 pre 上。
optionMeanings: 边顺依赖方向，入度记欠账。
边反着建，入度却仍加在后修上。
边方向对，入度加错了端点。
把入度计算推迟到遍历阶段。

Edges are reversed but the in-degree still lands on the course.
Edge direction is right but the in-degree lands on the wrong endpoint.
Defers the in-degree computation to the traversal phase.
optionDirectness: 入度归零恰好等于「先修都上完了」。
错在方向：减度会去减先修，队列永远推不动。
错在端点：起点入度被抬高，队列一开始就空。
错在时机：没有初始种子，循环根本起不来。

Wrong direction: decrements hit prerequisites, so the queue never advances.
Wrong endpoint: source nodes get non-zero in-degree and the queue starts empty.
Wrong timing: with no seed nodes the loop cannot start at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 入度：指向某节点的边数；在课程题里等于这门课还没上完的先修数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In-degree is the number of edges pointing at a node, which here means how many prerequisites a course still needs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 邻接表：每个节点存一条出边列表，空间 O(n + m)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An adjacency list stores an out-edge list per node and uses space proportional to nodes plus edges.

scenario: 面试官在我写完 Kahn 之后问复杂度。n 门课、m 条先修边，两种写法答案相同，我要一口气报完并说清依据。
scenario_en: After I finished Kahn's algorithm the interviewer asked for the complexity. With n courses and m prerequisite edges both variants give the same answer, and I should state it in one breath with the reason.
q: n 个节点 m 条边的拓扑排序，时间和空间各是多少、依据是什么？
q_en: For a topological sort over n nodes and m edges, what are the time and space costs and why?
text: 每个节点入队出队各一次、每条边被减度一次，所以时间是 {{O(n + m)}}；邻接表加入度数组加队列，空间是 {{O(n + m)}}。这个量级 {{BFS 版和 DFS 版相同}}。
text_en: Each node is enqueued and dequeued once and each edge is relaxed once, so time is {{O(n + m)}}; the adjacency list plus in-degree array plus queue give {{O(n + m)}} space, and this bound is {{the same for the BFS and DFS variants}}.
why: 复杂度不是背的，是数出来的：节点各进出一次、边各扫一次。报完量级顺带说「两版相同」，能挡掉「那 DFS 更快吗」这个追问。
why_en: I do not memorise the bound, I count it — every node enters and leaves once and every edge is scanned once, and both variants land on the same figure.

scenario: in-degree / out-degree 我一直混：phone screen 卡过一次，onsite Round 4 之后我自己写下的第一条 action item 就是「复习拓扑排序的 in-degree / out-degree」。
scenario_en: I keep mixing up in-degree and out-degree: it cost me time in a phone screen, and the first action item I wrote after onsite Round 4 was to review it.
q: 课程图里「这门课还欠几门先修」对应的是入度还是出度？
q_en: In a course graph, is how many prerequisites a course still owes the in-degree or the out-degree?
options: 出度，因为一门课解锁的后续课越多它越关键
入度，指向它的边数就是它还欠的先修数
两者之和，先修和后继都会阻塞这门课
出度，队列里要先放出度为 0 的末端课
options_en: Out-degree, because a course that unlocks more later courses matters more.
In-degree: the number of edges pointing at it is how many prerequisites it still owes.
The sum of both, since prerequisites and successors each block the course.
Out-degree, because the queue should start from terminal courses with out-degree zero.
tradeoff: 入度 vs 出度：入度记「欠账」所以能当就绪信号，出度记「影响面」只能拿来排优先级。
why: 边从先修指向后修时，指进来的边就是欠账，入度归零 = 可以上了。出度说的是它上完能解锁多少门，跟能不能开始无关。
why_en: With edges running from prerequisite to course, incoming edges are the debt, so in-degree hitting zero is the ready signal while out-degree only says how much it unlocks.
whenOtherWins: 如果我按「后修 → 先修」反向建图，欠账就变成出度，此时该盯出度归零——方向变了判据跟着变。
optionMeanings: 出度：从这个节点射出的边数。
入度：射向这个节点的边数。
把两个度数加起来当阻塞量。
以为种子节点是出度为 0 的末端课。
optionMeanings_en: Out-degree is the number of edges leaving the node.
In-degree is the number of edges arriving at the node.
Adds the two degrees together as one blocking count.
Assumes the seed nodes are terminal courses with out-degree zero.
optionDirectness: 把重要性和就绪条件混成同一件事。
欠账清零就是就绪，正是入队条件。
错在语义：后继再多也不妨碍这门课开课。
错在起点：末端课恰恰是最后才能上的。
optionDirectness_en: Conflates importance with readiness.
Debt hitting zero is readiness, which is exactly the enqueue rule.
Wrong semantics: having many successors never blocks the course itself.
Wrong seed: terminal courses are the ones you can only take last.
optionScenarioImpacts: 写出的减度循环会去更新错误的一端。
入队条件和减度对象一次说清，不再卡壳。
数组变成无意义的度数和，判据失效。
队列从终点出发，整个拓扑序反了。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The decrement loop then updates the wrong endpoint.
The enqueue rule and the decrement target both come out clean.
The array becomes a meaningless degree sum and the test breaks.
The queue starts at the sinks and the whole ordering comes out backwards.

termDefinitions.meaning: 出度：从一个节点射出的边数，在课程图里等于它能解锁的后续课数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Out-degree counts the edges leaving a node, which here means how many later courses it unlocks.

scenario: 四门课 A B C D，边是 A→C、B→C、C→D。Kahn 跑完之后我要用一个量回答「能不能上完」，而不是再跑一次检测。
scenario_en: Four courses A B C D with edges A to C, B to C and C to D. After Kahn's loop finishes I need one quantity that answers can I finish, not a second detection pass.
q: Kahn 跑完之后，用什么判定图里有环？
q_en: Once Kahn's loop ends, what tells me the graph has a cycle?
options: 队列提前枯竭，出队计数停在小于 n
任何一个节点的入度在循环中被减成负数
邻接表里出现了起点终点相同的自环边
队列在某一层同时出现两个入度 0 的节点
options_en: The queue dries up early and the dequeue count stops below n.
Some node's in-degree gets decremented below zero during the loop.
The adjacency list contains a self-loop whose two endpoints coincide.
Two in-degree-zero nodes sit in the queue at the same time.
tradeoff: 计数判据 vs 再跑一趟检测：靠 done 计数不多花一分钱，代价是它只说「有环」，不说环在哪。
why: 环上的节点入度永远降不到 0，队列会提前枯竭。出队计数小于 n 就是环的证据，不需要第二趟遍历。
why_en: Nodes on a cycle never reach in-degree zero, so the queue dries up early and a dequeue count below n is the proof.

optionMeanings: 用出队计数和 n 比对。
拿负入度当异常信号。
只查自环这一种特例。
把同层多节点当成分叉异常。
optionMeanings_en: Compares the dequeue count against n.
Treats a negative in-degree as the anomaly.
Only checks the self-loop special case.
Reads several same-layer nodes as a branching anomaly.
optionDirectness: 环上节点的入度卡住不降，计数必然缺口。

q: 把成对汇率喂进邻接表时，反方向的边该怎么建？

options: 只建正向边，反向查询时在 BFS 里临时取倒数

Store rate on the forward edge and its reciprocal on the reverse edge, building both.

why: 兑换天然双向，A→B 是 rate 就意味着 B→A 是 1/rate。在低频 ingest 阶段把两条边建好，高频读路径就只剩一次乘法。
why_en: Conversion is inherently two-way, so a rate from A to B means one over that rate from B to A, and building both edges at ingest keeps the hot read path to a single multiply.

codeSample:
from collections import defaultdict

def ingest_rate(conversions):
    graph = defaultdict(list)
    for c in conversions:                  # conversions = list of maps
        f, t, rate = c["from"], c["to"], c["rate"]
        if rate <= 0:                      # ingest 阶段挡脏数据
            continue
        graph[f].append((t, rate))
        graph[t].append((f, 1.0 / rate))   # 反向边取倒数
    return graph

scenario_en: Sai asked for the complexity of my currency BFS. With M currencies and N rate edges I need to say why it is linear, not just recite a symbol.
q: M 种货币、N 条汇率边的 BFS，时间和空间各是多少？
q_en: For a BFS over M currencies and N rate edges, what are the time and space costs?
text: 有 seen 集合时每种货币最多入队一次、每条边最多扫一次，时间是 {{O(M + N)}}；队列和 seen 各存不超过 M 个币种，空间是 {{O(M)}}。双向边让 N {{翻倍但不改变量级}}。
text_en: With the seen set each currency is enqueued at most once and each edge scanned once, so time is {{O(M + N)}}; the queue and seen set hold at most M currencies, so space is {{O(M)}}. Bidirectional edges {{double N without changing the order}}.
why: 线性的依据是 seen：它把「每个节点至多访问一次」变成保证。顺带说一句双向边只把 N 翻倍、不改量级，能挡掉「建两条边不是更慢吗」。
why_en: The seen set is what makes it linear, and mentioning that bidirectional edges only double N heads off the follow-up about the extra edges.

scenario_en: Amazon Round 4 follow-up: if the edges are weighted and you want the numerically best rate rather than the fewest hops, how does the algorithm change? I floated A star, admitted it did not fit, and only reached Bellman-Ford after a nudge.
q: 要「数值最优兑换率」而不是最少跳数时，该换成哪类算法？
q_en: To get the numerically best conversion rate instead of the fewest hops, which family of algorithm do I switch to?

A weighted shortest-path algorithm such as Bellman-Ford or Dijkstra.

why: BFS 只在「每条边代价相同」时最优，一旦要比较路径的汇率乘积，就得进最短路家族；有负权或要检测套利环时只有 Bellman-Ford 成立。

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A-star search uses a heuristic estimate of the remaining cost to the goal so it expands the most promising nodes first.

termDefinitions.meaning: 松弛：若经过某条边能得到更优的距离，就更新终点的当前最优值。

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bellman-Ford is a single-source shortest-path algorithm that relaxes every edge V minus one times and tolerates negative weights.

scenario: 汇率沿路径是相乘的，最短路算法沿路径是相加的。Round 4 的加分点我没自己抛出来：把乘法问题变成加法问题的那一步变换。
scenario_en: Rates multiply along a path while shortest-path algorithms add along a path. The bonus point I failed to volunteer in Round 4 is the transform that turns multiplication into addition.
q: 把「汇率乘积最大」变成标准最短路问题，边权该怎么取？
q_en: To turn 'maximise the product of rates' into a standard shortest-path problem, what should the edge weight be?
options: 取 1 / rate 作边权，最小化倒数之和
取 -log(rate) 作边权，最小化权重之和
取 log(rate) 作边权，最小化权重之和
取 rate 本身作边权，最大化权重之和
options_en: Use one over rate as the weight and minimise the sum of reciprocals.
Use minus log of rate as the weight and minimise the sum of weights.
Use log of rate as the weight and minimise the sum of weights.
Use the rate itself as the weight and maximise the sum of weights.
why: log 把乘法变成加法：最大化 ∏rate 等价于最大化 Σlog(rate)，再取负号就变成标准的「最小化 Σ(-log rate)」，最短路的答案就是最优兑换率。
why_en: Taking logs turns the product into a sum, and the minus sign flips maximisation into the minimisation that shortest-path algorithms already solve.
codeSample:
import math

# 汇率相乘 → 权重相加
w = -math.log(rate)          # rate>1 → w<0；rate<1 → w>0

# 一条路径的权重和
# sum(-log r_i) = -log(∏ r_i)
# 权重和最小  ⇔  汇率乘积最大
best_rate = math.exp(-total_weight)   # 反解回汇率

# 负权环 sum < 0 ⇔ ∏ rate > 1 ⇔ 存在套利

负对数：把乘法结构映射成可相加的代价。

直接用汇率当权重并求最大和。

Negative logarithm maps the multiplicative structure onto additive costs.
Plain logarithm: right idea but never flipped into a minimisation.
Uses the rate directly as a weight and maximises the sum.

唯一能让「和最小」严格对应「积最大」的取法。
错在符号：最大化 Σlog 才对应最优，最小化会取反。
错在结构：路径上汇率是连乘，加起来没有意义。

The only transform under which a minimal sum exactly matches a maximal product.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A logarithm turns a product into a sum because the log of a times b equals the log of a plus the log of b.

termDefinitions.meaning: 负权环：环上所有边的权重之和为负，在这里等价于绕一圈能赚钱。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A negative cycle is a loop whose edge weights sum to less than zero, which here means going round the loop makes money.

scenario: 把边权取成 -log(rate) 之后，面试官问：「如果你的算法报告说图里有负权环，业务上意味着什么？」
scenario_en: After switching the edge weights to minus log of rate, the interviewer asks what it means for the business if the algorithm reports a negative cycle.
q: -log 权重下出现负权环，业务含义是什么、该怎么处理？
q_en: Under minus-log weights, what does a negative cycle mean in business terms and how should the code react?
options: 数据里有一条汇率是负数，应该在 ingest 阶段过滤掉
存在套利环：绕一圈换回原币种能变多，最优汇率无下界
图不连通，说明这两种货币之间没有可行的兑换链
浮点误差累积导致的假阳性，加一个极小的容差即可
options_en: Some rate in the feed is negative and should be filtered out at ingest.
There is an arbitrage cycle: going round it returns more of the starting currency, so the optimum is unbounded.
The graph is disconnected, meaning no conversion chain exists between the two currencies.
It is a false positive from accumulated floating-point error, so add a small tolerance.
tradeoff: 报错退出 vs 直接返回环：把负环当异常上报最安全，代价是放弃了「这条环本身就是可交易信号」的商业价值。
why: 环上 Σ(-log rate) < 0 等价于 ∏rate > 1，绕一圈钱变多。此时「最优兑换率」在数学上无上界，算法必须先报出这个环而不是继续松弛。
why_en: A negative cycle means the rates around the loop multiply to more than one, so the best rate is unbounded and the algorithm must report the loop instead of relaxing forever.

scenario: 教练在白板上把最短路分成单源和全源两类，问我汇率题属于哪一类。题面是「给 source 和 target，算出兑换率」，且 ingest 每天只跑一次、查询高频。
scenario_en: My coach split shortest paths into single-source and all-pairs on the whiteboard and asked which one the currency problem is. The prompt gives one source and one target, ingest runs daily and queries are frequent.
q: 「给定 source 和 target 算兑换率」该用单源还是全源算法？
q_en: Given one source and one target, is this a single-source or an all-pairs problem?
options: 全源：反正 ingest 时要遍历整张图，顺便算完所有点对最省事
单源：每次查询只关心一个起点，从它出发松弛即可

Single-source: each query cares about one starting currency, so relax outward from it.

All-pairs: there are only two hundred currencies, so cubic time runs fine.
tradeoff: 单源按需算 vs 全源预计算：单源每次查询自己算、内存只存图；全源在 ingest 时一次性付出 O(V³)，换来查询 O(1) 但要存 V² 张表。

q: 边权取 -log(rate) 之后，为什么不能默认用 Dijkstra？
q_en: Once the weights are minus log of rate, why can't I default to Dijkstra?
options: 因为 Dijkstra 只能跑无向图，而汇率图是有向的
因为 rate > 1 时 -log(rate) 为负，前提被破坏
因为 Dijkstra 需要提前知道目标节点，这里目标是变量
因为对数结果是浮点数，而 Dijkstra 的优先队列只接受整数键
options_en: Because Dijkstra only runs on undirected graphs while the rate graph is directed.
Because a rate above one makes minus log of rate negative, which breaks the precondition.
Because Dijkstra needs the target node up front and here the target is a variable.
Because a logarithm yields a float and Dijkstra priority queues only accept integer keys.
tradeoff: Dijkstra vs Bellman-Ford：Dijkstra 近线性但要求边权非负，Bellman-Ford 慢到 O(V·E)，换来负权可用和负环可检测。
why: Dijkstra 靠「已出堆的节点不会再变短」这条贪心不变量，负权边会让一个更晚发现的路径反超，不变量失效。汇率里 rate>1 的边天然带来负权。
why_en: Dijkstra assumes a settled node can never get cheaper, and a negative edge breaks that invariant, which is exactly what a rate above one produces.
whenOtherWins: 如果能保证所有边权非负——比如把汇率全部归一化到不超过 1，或题目只有手续费这种正代价——Dijkstra 就是更快的选择。

用 float 但每步都加一个极小容差，避免比较出错

Floats for the ratio maths, Decimal for the amounts that get booked.

why: 汇率是比例、需要连乘，用浮点字面量就够；但入账金额要能精确到分且可复现，那一层换成十进制定点。先写 1.0 不写 1，是这条规则最小的落点。

whenOtherWins: 如果整个系统只做记账加减、不做连乘比例，那从头到尾用整数分单位最省事，连 Decimal 都不需要。

所有环节都用整数定点。

scenario: Anytime AI 编码热身：二分查找我写出了死循环，运行时卡住，当场没定位到是哪一行。
scenario_en: Anytime AI coding warm-up: my binary search hit an infinite loop at runtime and I could not spot the offending line on the spot.
q: 闭区间二分里，哪一行的写法会直接造成死循环？
q_en: In a closed-interval binary search, which line is the one that actually causes the infinite loop?
options: mid 写成 (left + right) // 2 而不是 left + (right - left) // 2
循环条件写成 while left <= right 而不是 left < right
把 left = mid + 1 写成 left = mid，区间不再收缩
初始 right 写成 len(nums) 而不是 len(nums) - 1
options_en: Computing mid as left plus right over two instead of left plus half the gap.
Writing the loop condition as while left is at most right instead of strictly less than.
Writing left equals mid instead of left equals mid plus one, so the interval stops shrinking.
Initialising right to the array length instead of the length minus one.
tradeoff: 闭区间 vs 半开区间：闭区间三处必须配套（<=、mid+1、mid-1），换来最好记；半开区间允许 right = mid，但循环条件必须改成 <。
why: 死循环的唯一根因是区间没收缩：当 left == right 时 mid 恒等于 left，写 left = mid 就永远停在原地。+1 / -1 保证每轮至少排除一个元素。
why_en: The loop only hangs when the interval stops shrinking, because with left equal to right the midpoint never moves unless you add one.
whenOtherWins: 找左边界那种下界二分里，right = mid 是对的——但此时循环条件必须是 while left < right，两者要成套换。
optionMeanings: 溢出保护的写法差异。
循环条件的开闭差异。
指针更新没有跨过 mid。
初始右端点的取值差异。
optionMeanings_en: A difference in overflow-safe arithmetic.
A difference in whether the loop bound is inclusive.
A pointer update that fails to step past the midpoint.
A difference in the initial right endpoint.
optionDirectness: 在 Python 里整数无上限，这只影响 C/Java。
配合 mid±1 时 <= 才是对的，单独换会漏掉末元素。
两端相遇时 mid 落回 left，指针原地不动。
会越界读取，但报错退出而不是挂住。
optionDirectness_en: Python integers are unbounded, so this only matters in C or Java.
With mid plus or minus one the inclusive bound is correct; changing it alone drops the last element.
When the pointers meet the midpoint falls back onto left and nothing moves.
It reads out of bounds, which raises and exits rather than hanging.
optionScenarioImpacts: 改了它程序照样挂住，浪费调试时间。
改成 < 之后单元素数组会被漏掉，答案变错。
这就是我当天那行，改成 mid + 1 立刻通过。
会看到 IndexError，比死循环更容易定位。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Changing it leaves the program hanging and wastes debugging time.
Switching to a strict bound drops single-element arrays and returns the wrong answer.
That was my line on the day, and mid plus one fixed it immediately.
It raises an index error, which is far easier to locate than a hang.

termDefinitions.meaning: 闭区间：搜索范围包含 left 和 right 两端，对应 while left <= right。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A closed interval includes both endpoints, which pairs with a loop condition of left at most right.

scenario: 二分是最常见的热身题，我却在 Anytime AI 现场写挂了。需要一个「三处必须配套」的记忆锚，写的时候一眼自检。
scenario_en: Binary search is the most common warm-up and I still broke it live at Anytime AI. I need a three-part memory anchor I can self-check at a glance.
q: 标准闭区间二分，哪三处写法必须成套出现？
q_en: In the standard closed-interval binary search, which three lines must appear as a matched set?
text: 闭区间三件套：循环条件 {{while left <= right}}、右移写 {{left = mid + 1}}、左移写 {{right = mid - 1}}；任何一处不配套就要么死循环、要么漏掉末元素。复杂度 {{O(log n)}}。
text_en: The closed-interval trio: the loop condition {{while left <= right}}, the right move {{left = mid + 1}} and the left move {{right = mid - 1}}; break the set and you either hang or miss the last element. The cost is {{O(log n)}}.
why: 三处是一个整体：条件决定区间开闭，两处更新决定是否收缩。写完扫一眼这三行，比事后调试死循环快得多。
why_en: The three lines are one unit — the condition sets the interval type and the two updates decide whether it shrinks — so scanning them beats debugging a hang.

scenario: 面试官把题改成「返回第一个大于等于 target 的下标」——数组里 target 可能重复出现，要的是最左边那个位置。
scenario_en: The interviewer changes the ask to the index of the first element at least as large as the target, where the target may repeat and the leftmost position is wanted.
q: 求下界（第一个 >= target 的位置）时，模板要怎么改？
q_en: For a lower bound — the first index whose value is at least the target — how does the template change?
options: 保持 while left <= right，命中时直接返回 mid
保持 while left <= right，命中时把 right = mid 继续向左缩
改成 while left < right，右端写 right = mid 不减一
改成 while left < right，命中时 left = mid 继续向右缩
options_en: Keep the inclusive loop and return mid as soon as a match is found.
Keep the inclusive loop but set right to mid on a match and keep shrinking leftward.
Switch to a strict loop and move the right pointer to mid without subtracting one.
Switch to a strict loop but set left to mid on a match and keep shrinking rightward.
tradeoff: 找到即返回 vs 收敛到边界：前者代码短但只对唯一元素成立，后者多跑几轮，换来重复元素下的确定边界。
why: 下界的关键是「不排除 mid 本身」，所以右端写 right = mid；一旦不再减一，循环条件必须换成 left < right，否则 left==right 时又卡死。
why_en: A lower bound must keep the midpoint as a candidate, so the right pointer moves to mid, and that forces the strict loop condition to avoid hanging.
whenOtherWins: 如果数组保证元素互不相同、且只问「在不在」，那闭区间模板命中即返回反而更短更快。
optionMeanings: 沿用闭区间模板并提前返回。
闭区间条件配上不减一的右移。
半开收敛：保留 mid 为候选，逼到唯一位置。
半开条件配上不加一的左移。
optionMeanings_en: Reuses the inclusive template with an early return.
Pairs the inclusive condition with a right move that does not subtract one.
Strict convergence: keeps mid as a candidate and narrows to a single index.
Pairs the strict condition with a left move that does not add one.
optionDirectness: 错在语义：重复元素时返回的是任意一个，不是最左。
错在配套：<= 加 right = mid，left==right 时死循环。
保留 mid 才能收到最左位置；另一侧仍写 left = mid + 1。
错在方向：left = mid 在长度 2 的区间上不收缩。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong semantics: with duplicates it returns an arbitrary match, not the leftmost.
Mismatched set: an inclusive bound with right equal to mid hangs when the pointers meet.
Keeping mid is what converges on the leftmost index, while the other side still moves to mid plus one.
Wrong direction: left equal to mid fails to shrink a two-element window.
optionScenarioImpacts: 在有重复值的数组上答案不稳定，测试会随机挂。
又写出一次死循环，和上次是同一个病根。
同一个模板还能改出上界，只换比较符。
循环卡住，和闭区间那次的失败模式一样。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: On arrays with duplicates the answer is unstable and tests fail intermittently.
It reproduces the same hang as before from the same root cause.
The same shape yields the upper bound by flipping the comparison.
The loop sticks in exactly the way it did the first time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下界：第一个不小于 target 的位置，C++ 的 lower_bound、Python 的 bisect_left 都是它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lower bound is the first position whose value is not less than the target, matching bisect_left in Python.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上界：第一个严格大于 target 的位置，对应 Python 的 bisect_right。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An upper bound is the first position whose value is strictly greater than the target, matching bisect_right in Python.

scenario: Alterion 技术面：我写 Trie 的 insert 时直接给每个字符建新节点，面试官提示「you're overriding each character with a new tri node」我才发现。
scenario_en: Alterion technical interview: my Trie insert created a fresh node for every character until the interviewer pointed out that I was overwriting each character with a new node.
q: Trie 的 insert 里，创建新节点之前必须先做什么？
q_en: In a Trie insert, what has to happen before a new node is created?
options: 先检查 node.children 里是否已有这个字符，有就复用
先把当前节点的 is_end 置为 False，避免把前缀误判成词尾
先检查整个单词是否已存在，存在就直接返回
先按字母表大小预分配 26 个子节点槽位
options_en: Check whether the character already exists in node.children and reuse it if so.
Reset the current node is_end flag to false so a prefix is not mistaken for a word end.
Check whether the whole word already exists and return early if it does.
Pre-allocate twenty-six child slots according to the alphabet size.
tradeoff: 复用已有子节点 vs 每次新建：复用是 Trie 共享前缀的全部意义所在，新建则等于把树退化成一堆互不相干的链。
why: Trie 的价值就是共享前缀。不检查就新建，会把已有子树整个换掉，所有共享该前缀的词一起消失——这是这道题最常见的 bug。
why_en: A Trie exists to share prefixes, so creating a node without checking replaces an entire subtree and silently deletes every word under that prefix.
whenOtherWins: 如果结构不是 Trie 而是每个词一条独立链（比如只统计词频的链表桶），那不检查直接建反而没有副作用。
optionMeanings: 存在即复用，不存在才新建。
把词尾标记当成需要清理的状态。
在插入前做一次完整的存在性查询。
按字母表预留固定宽度的子节点数组。
optionMeanings_en: Reuse when present, allocate only when absent.
Treats the word-end flag as state that needs clearing.
Runs a full existence lookup before inserting.
Reserves a fixed-width child array sized to the alphabet.
optionDirectness: 共享前缀的唯一保障，也是这题的正确写法。
错在方向：is_end 只该置 True，清掉等于删词。
错在必要性：复用逻辑本身已经天然幂等。
这是空间换时间的实现细节，救不了覆盖 bug。
optionDirectness_en: The one guarantee that prefixes stay shared, and the fix this problem wants.
Wrong direction: is_end should only ever be set, and clearing it deletes words.
Unnecessary: the reuse logic is already idempotent by construction.
A space-for-time detail that does nothing about the overwrite bug.
optionScenarioImpacts: 插入 car 之后再插 cart，两个词都还在。
插完 car 再插 cart 会把 car 从结果里抹掉。
多一次 O(L) 查询，正确性没变。
内存涨到 26 倍，覆盖问题原样存在。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Insert car then cart and both words survive.
Inserting cart after car would erase car from the results.
Adds one linear lookup without changing correctness.
Memory grows twenty-six fold and the overwrite bug is untouched.

termDefinitions.meaning: Trie：按字符逐层分叉的前缀树，共享公共前缀，用于自动补全和前缀查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A trie is a prefix tree that branches one character at a time and shares common prefixes, used for autocomplete and prefix lookup.

termDefinitions.meaning: is_end：标记这个节点是否是某个完整单词的结尾，区别于纯前缀节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The is_end flag marks whether a node terminates a complete word rather than being only a prefix.

scenario: Alterion 第二个 bug 在 starts_with 的 DFS 里，也是面试官提示「must be something in the DFS」才找到。词典里有 car / cart / cape，查询前缀 ca。
scenario_en: The second Alterion bug lived in the DFS inside starts_with, and again the interviewer had to say the problem must be in the DFS. The dictionary holds car, cart and cape, and the query prefix is ca.
q: starts_with(prefix) 返回所有匹配词，正确的两步是什么？
q_en: To make starts_with return every matching word, what are the two correct steps?
options: 从根 DFS 整棵树，把以 prefix 开头的词筛出来
先走到前缀终点节点，再从它 DFS 收集所有 is_end 路径
先走到前缀终点节点，返回它 children 里的所有直接子节点
对词典里每个词逐个做 startswith 判断并收集
options_en: Run a DFS from the root over the whole tree and filter the words that start with the prefix.
Walk to the node at the end of the prefix, then DFS from there collecting every is_end path.
Walk to the node at the end of the prefix and return all of its immediate children.
Test every word in the dictionary with a startswith check and collect the matches.
tradeoff: 先定位再 DFS vs 全树扫描：定位把搜索范围从整棵树压到一棵子树，代价是要先处理「前缀不存在」的提前返回。
why: 两步是分开的：第一步按前缀逐字符下潜，中途缺字符就返回空；第二步从那个节点 DFS，沿途累积字符串，遇到 is_end 就收一条。
why_en: The two steps are separate — walk down character by character and bail out if a character is missing, then depth-first from that node collecting every path that ends a word.
whenOtherWins: 如果只查一次、词典又很小，直接遍历词表做前缀匹配更省事——建 Trie 的成本还不如省下的那点查询时间。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  R((root)) --> C["c"]
  C --> A["a · 前缀 ca 终点"]
  A --> R2["r · is_end=True → car"]
  R2 --> T["t · is_end=True → cart"]
  A --> P["p"]
  P --> E["e · is_end=True → cape"]
optionMeanings: 不定位，直接全树遍历后过滤。
定位到前缀节点后再做子树 DFS。
只取一层子节点，不往下递归。
完全绕开 Trie，回到线性扫描。
optionMeanings_en: Skips the walk and filters after traversing everything.
Locates the prefix node first, then depth-first over that subtree.
Takes only one level of children without recursing.
Bypasses the trie entirely and scans linearly.
optionDirectness: 错在范围：把 O(子树) 做成 O(全树)，前缀树白建了。
定位加子树遍历，正好是 Trie 的设计意图。
错在深度：cart 这种更长的词一个都收不到。
错在结构：查询成本回到 O(词数 × 词长)。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong scope: it turns a subtree walk into a whole-tree walk and wastes the trie.
Locate then walk the subtree is exactly what a trie is built for.
Wrong depth: longer words such as cart are never collected.
Wrong structure: query cost falls back to word count times word length.
optionScenarioImpacts: 词典变大后查询明显变慢，面试官会追问。
ca 能一次收齐 car、cart、cape 三个词。
查 ca 只返回 r 和 p 两个字符，不是单词。
面试官会问「那你为什么要建 Trie」。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Queries slow down visibly as the dictionary grows and that draws a follow-up.
The prefix ca returns car, cart and cape in one pass.
Querying ca returns the letters r and p rather than words.
It invites the question of why the trie was built at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 子树：以某个节点为根的整棵下挂结构，前缀查询只需遍历它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A subtree is everything hanging below a given node, and a prefix query only needs to traverse that part.

scenario: 面试官在我写完 Trie 后问复杂度。词典有 N 个词、查询词长 L、字符集 26，我要说清「为什么和词数无关」。
scenario_en: After I finished the Trie the interviewer asked for complexity. With N words in the dictionary, a query of length L and a 26-letter alphabet, I need to explain why the word count drops out.
q: Trie 的 insert / search 复杂度是多少，为什么和词典大小无关？
q_en: What are the insert and search costs of a trie, and why do they not depend on dictionary size?
text: insert 和 search 都只沿一条路径走 L 步，每步在 children 里做一次哈希查找，所以是 {{O(L)}}，与词数 N {{无关}}。starts_with 还要加上子树遍历，是 {{O(L + 结果总字符数)}}；最坏空间 {{O(N × L)}} 个节点。
text_en: Insert and search walk one path of length L doing a constant-time child lookup at each step, so both are {{O(L)}} and {{independent of}} the word count N. A prefix query adds the subtree walk, giving {{O(L plus the total characters returned)}}, and worst-case space is {{O(N times L)}} nodes.
why: 路径长度只由词长决定，所以词典再大查询也不变慢——这正是自动补全选 Trie 而不是遍历词表的理由。代价是节点数会随不共享前缀的词线性膨胀。
why_en: The path length depends only on the word, so a bigger dictionary does not slow lookups, and that is exactly why autocomplete uses a trie.

scenario: Convoke 现场编码（Google Doc，无 IDE）：「不用内置 dict 实现一个字典」。我先说哈希集加链表，方向对，接着跑偏到跳表，被问「Python 的字典怎么实现的」时重建不出机制。
scenario_en: Convoke live coding in a Google Doc with no IDE: implement a dictionary without using a dict. I started with a hash set plus linked list, which was right, then drifted to a skip list and could not reconstruct the mechanism when asked how Python's dict works.
q: 「不用 dict 实现 dict」，该给出的核心机制链是什么？
q_en: For 'implement a dictionary without a dictionary', what is the core mechanism chain to state?
options: 跳表：多层索引让查找降到 O(log n)，插入时随机决定层数
平衡二叉搜索树：按 key 排序，查找插入都稳定 O(log n)
有序数组加二分查找：查找 O(log n)，插入时整体后移
哈希函数算出桶下标，桶内挂链表处理冲突，平均 O(1)
options_en: A skip list: layered indexes bring lookup to logarithmic time and each insert picks a random height.
A balanced binary search tree: keys stay sorted and both lookup and insert are logarithmic.

def interval_intersection(A, B):
    i = j = 0
    out = []
    while i < len(A) and j < len(B):
        lo = max(A[i][0], B[j][0])      # 左端取较大的起点
        hi = min(A[i][1], B[j][1])      # 右端取较小的终点
        if lo <= hi:                    # 空交集的唯一判据
            out.append([lo, hi])
        if A[i][1] < B[j][1]:           # 终点小的那侧先推进
            i += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    return out

用长度而不是端点来定结果。

这是并集的公式，交集要反过来取。

Wrong granularity: all four branches compute the same max and min.
That is the union formula; intersection takes the opposite ends.

四个分支里漏掉一个，边界用例就挂。
返回的区间比任何一个输入都长，明显不对。
重叠一半时会返回不存在的区段。

Miss one of the four branches and an edge case fails.
It returns a span longer than either input, which is visibly wrong.

scenario: Anytime AI 真题：TikTok 广告配置页有个异步 API 给推荐值。用户在 loading 中切走页面，或两个请求快速连发导致响应乱序。我当时只答了「加 loading overlay」。
scenario_en: Anytime AI, a real question about the TikTok campaign config page: an async API returns recommended values. The user navigates away while loading, or two requests fire back to back and the responses arrive out of order. All I said was to add a loading overlay.
q: 异步响应乱序 + 用户中途切页，三层防线该按什么顺序讲？
q_en: Out-of-order async responses plus a user navigating away — in what order do the three defences go?
steps: 响应回来时对比 sequence 编号，不是最新的那个直接丢弃
用户切走页面或新请求发出时，用 AbortController 取消飞行中的旧请求
关键状态以服务端返回为准，前端的乐观值最终被服务端覆盖
每次发请求前给它打一个单调递增的 sequence 编号
why: 先在源头取消，再给还活着的请求编号，响应回来按编号丢弃过期的，最后用服务端兜底。我当天只讲了 UI 层的 loading，三层一层都没提。
why_en: Cancel at the source first, tag whatever survives, discard stale responses by tag, and let the server be the final authority.

termDefinitions.meaning: AbortController：浏览器 API，通过 signal 让 fetch 提前中止，promise 以 AbortError 拒绝。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AbortController is a browser API whose signal lets a fetch be cancelled early, rejecting the promise with an abort error.

termDefinitions.meaning: sequence 编号：给每个请求打的单调递增序号，用来识别哪个响应是最新的。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A request sequence tag is a monotonically increasing number attached to each request so the newest response can be identified.

termDefinitions.meaning: 乐观更新：先按预期改本地状态，等服务端确认后再校正。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An optimistic update changes local state immediately and reconciles once the server confirms.

scenario: 我答完「用 AbortController 取消请求」，面试官追问：「那服务端那边呢？请求已经发出去了，取消能让它停下来吗？」
scenario_en: After I said I would cancel with AbortController, the interviewer asked what happens on the server: the request is already out, so does cancelling stop it?
q: AbortController 取消一个已发出的请求，服务端会怎样？
q_en: When AbortController cancels a request that has already gone out, what happens on the server?
options: 服务端会收到取消信号并回滚已经开始的处理
浏览器停止接收响应，服务端可能已经在处理并跑完
请求会被浏览器从连接上撤回，服务端根本收不到
服务端会把该请求标记为超时并自动重试一次
options_en: The server receives a cancel signal and rolls back whatever it started.
The browser stops consuming the response while the server may already be running the work to completion.
The browser withdraws the request from the connection so the server never sees it.
The server marks the request as timed out and automatically retries it once.
tradeoff: 客户端取消 vs 服务端取消：AbortController 便宜、只保护前端状态，代价是副作用仍会发生；真正的服务端取消要额外设计一个取消接口和幂等写。
why: abort 是客户端语义：fetch 的 promise 以 AbortError 拒绝、连接被丢弃，但请求若已到达服务端，处理照常进行。所以有副作用的写操作必须另配取消接口或幂等键。
why_en: Abort is a client-side contract — the promise rejects and the connection is dropped — but work already running on the server keeps going.
whenOtherWins: 如果这个接口是纯读、无副作用，那客户端取消就够了，再去设计服务端取消属于过度设计。
optionMeanings: 认为取消信号会传播到服务端。
取消只作用在客户端这一侧。
认为请求可以从网络上撤回。
把取消当成超时重试机制。
optionMeanings_en: Assumes the cancel signal propagates to the server.
Cancellation applies only on the client side.
Assumes a request can be pulled back off the wire.
Treats cancellation as a timeout-and-retry mechanism.
optionDirectness: 错在边界：HTTP 没有让客户端回滚服务端事务的语义。
分清了「不看响应」和「不做事」这两件事。
错在时机：只有还没发出的请求才可能不发。
错在方向：重试会把副作用再执行一遍。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong boundary: HTTP gives the client no way to roll back a server transaction.
Separates 'ignore the response' from 'do no work'.
Wrong timing: only a request that has not left yet can be withheld.
Wrong direction: a retry would run the side effect a second time.
optionScenarioImpacts: 会声称写操作自动安全，实际数据已经落库。
能接着说「所以写接口要幂等键或取消端点」。
面试官一句「已经发出去了呢」就问倒了。
把竞态答成了可靠性，还引入重复执行风险。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It claims writes are automatically safe when the data is already committed.
It leads into idempotency keys or a dedicated cancel endpoint for writes.
One follow-up about a request already in flight ends the answer.
It answers a race question with a reliability story and adds duplicate execution risk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 幂等：同一个请求执行多次和执行一次的结果相同，通常靠幂等键实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotency means running the same request twice leaves the same result as running it once, usually enforced with an idempotency key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 副作用：请求除了返回数据之外还改变了服务端状态，比如写库或扣款。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A side effect is any server state change a request makes beyond returning data, such as writing to a database.

scenario: Amazon onsite Round 2 拼词题：7 张字母牌、一份词表、字母分值表，返回能拼出的 Top-5 高分词。这一轮我发挥很好，要把它固化成模板。
scenario_en: Amazon onsite Round 2, the word game: seven letter tiles, a word list and a letter-score map, return the top five buildable words. This round went well and I want to lock the pattern in.
q: 判断一个词能否用手上的 7 张牌拼出来，该用什么原语？
q_en: To decide whether a word can be built from seven tiles, which primitive should I reach for?
options: 对手牌做频率 Counter，逐字符比计数是否够用
枚举手牌的全部排列，看词是否出现在排列的前缀里
把手牌和词分别排序，再做逐字符的子序列匹配
为每个词建一个集合，判断它是不是手牌集合的子集
options_en: Build a frequency Counter of the hand and check, letter by letter, whether the counts suffice.
Enumerate every permutation of the hand and see whether the word appears as a prefix.
Sort the hand and the word separately, then run a character-by-character subsequence match.
Build a set per word and test whether it is a subset of the hand's set.
tradeoff: 频率表 vs 排列枚举：Counter 把可行性判断压到 O(词长)，代价是要额外记住「重复字母靠计数而不是靠存在性」。
why: 这是多重集包含判断：每个字母的需求量不能超过手上的持有量。第一个不够的字母就 break，每个词只花 O(词长)，不需要任何排列。
why_en: It is a multiset containment test — no letter may be demanded more times than the hand holds it — and the first shortfall lets you break out.
whenOtherWins: 如果牌可以重复使用无限次（比如印章而不是牌），那就退化成集合子集判断，Counter 的计数信息反而多余。
codeSample:
from collections import Counter

def top_k(hand, words, points, k=5):
    have = Counter(hand)
    out = []
    for w in set(words):                 # set 去掉重复单词
        need = Counter(w)
        if all(need[c] <= have[c] for c in need):   # 多重集包含
            out.append((w, sum(points[c] * n for c, n in need.items())))
    out.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))   # 分数降序，同分按字母序
    return out[:k]                          # 不足 k 个时切片天然安全
optionMeanings: 按字母计数做包含判断。
穷举排列后做前缀匹配。
排序后当作子序列问题。
退化成集合的子集判断。
optionMeanings_en: Counts letters and tests containment.
Enumerates permutations and matches prefixes.
Sorts first and treats it as a subsequence problem.
Reduces the test to set inclusion.
optionDirectness: 计数保住了重复字母的信息，正是这题的核心。
错在量级：7 张牌就有 5040 种排列，词表一大就崩。
方向可行但多花一次排序，且要自己处理重复。
错在信息量：集合丢掉计数，EE 会被当成一个 E 放行。
optionDirectness_en: Counting preserves duplicate-letter information, which is the crux here.
Wrong scale: seven tiles already give five thousand permutations.
Workable but pays an extra sort and still needs duplicate handling.
Wrong information: a set drops counts, so a double letter passes on a single tile.
optionScenarioImpacts: 总复杂度落在 O(词数 × 词长) 加一次排序。
面试官会立刻问复杂度，然后这条路就断了。
能跑但讲解更绕，白花时间解释排序为什么必要。
会把拼不出的词报成可拼，结果直接错。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Total cost lands at words times length plus one sort.
The complexity question comes instantly and the approach collapses.
It runs but takes longer to explain why the sort is needed.
It reports unbuildable words as buildable and the answer is simply wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多重集：允许元素重复出现的集合，比较时要比计数而不只是存在性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A multiset allows repeated elements, so comparisons must look at counts rather than mere membership.

termDefinitions.meaning: Counter：Python 里按元素计数的字典子类，Python 3.10 起还直接支持子集比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Counter is a Python dictionary subclass that tallies elements, and since version three point ten it supports subset comparison directly.

scenario: Round 2 追问：手牌里加入 wildcard 空白牌，它能代表任意字母，但算分时固定算 1 分而不是被代表字母的真实分值。
scenario_en: Round 2 follow-up: the hand now includes blank wildcard tiles that stand for any letter, but a wildcard always scores one point rather than the value of the letter it represents.
q: 加入 wildcard 之后，可拼判断和算分各要怎么改？
q_en: With wildcards added, how do the buildability check and the scoring each change?
options: 把 wildcard 展开成 26 种字母，对每一种可能各判一次可拼性
在手牌 Counter 里给每个字母都加上 wildcard 的数量
wildcard 单独计数：真实字母不够时才消耗一个，算分按固定 1 分
把 wildcard 当成分值最高的那个字母，保证得分最大化
options_en: Expand each wildcard into all twenty-six letters and test buildability for every possibility.
Add the wildcard count to every letter's tally inside the hand Counter.
Count wildcards separately, spend one only when a real letter runs short, and score each at a flat one point.
Treat a wildcard as whichever letter scores highest so the total is maximised.
tradeoff: 单独计数 vs 展开枚举：单独计数让判断仍是 O(词长)，代价是要显式记住「用了几张 wildcard」以便算分时减掉真实分值。
why: 两件事要解耦：可行性上 wildcard 是通用替补，先花真实字母、不够才动它；算分上它的分值和代表的字母无关，固定加 1。
why_en: Keep the two rules separate: for feasibility a wildcard is a spare tile spent only when a real letter runs out, and for scoring it is worth a flat one regardless of the letter.
whenOtherWins: 如果规则改成「wildcard 按代表字母计分」，那贪心就要反过来——优先让 wildcard 去顶最贵的字母，判断和算分重新耦合。
optionMeanings: 对每种代表字母穷举一遍。
把 wildcard 加进每个字母的计数。
wildcard 自成一个计数，按需消耗。
让 wildcard 总代表最贵的字母。
optionMeanings_en: Enumerates every letter a wildcard could stand for.
Folds the wildcard count into every letter's tally.
Wildcards get their own tally and are spent on demand.
Makes a wildcard always represent the priciest letter.
optionDirectness: 错在量级：两张 wildcard 就是 676 种组合，白烧时间。
错在总量：一张 wildcard 被同时算给多个字母，会超发。
先真实后替补，一次扫描就能得出缺口数。
错在规则：题面说 wildcard 固定 1 分，与代表字母无关。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong scale: two wildcards already mean hundreds of combinations for nothing.
Wrong total: one wildcard gets credited to several letters at once and over-issues tiles.
Real letters first, spare second, so one scan yields the shortfall.
Wrong rule: the prompt fixes a wildcard at one point regardless of the letter.
optionScenarioImpacts: 面试官只要 pseudo code，穷举会显得没抓住重点。
会把拼不出的词判成可拼，正确性直接坏掉。
判断和算分分两句讲清，追问就此收尾。
分数一律偏高，和题目给的算分规则对不上。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The interviewer only wanted pseudo code, so enumeration looks like missing the point.
It marks unbuildable words as buildable and correctness breaks outright.
Two sentences cover feasibility and scoring and the follow-up closes.
Every score comes out inflated against the stated rule.

termDefinitions.meaning: wildcard：空白牌，可以代表任意字母，但计分时按固定值算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A wildcard is a blank tile that can stand for any letter while scoring a fixed value.

termDefinitions.meaning: 贪心分配：优先消耗受限较少的资源，这里是先用真实字母再动 wildcard。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Greedy allocation spends the less constrained resource first, here real letters before wildcards.

scenario: Alterion 第二题：写一个 AgentRegistry，支持 register / remove(agent_id) / get(agent_id) / list(filter)。我在「infra、tags 放 key 侧还是 value 侧」上纠结，要面试官引导才定下来。
scenario_en: Alterion's second exercise: build an AgentRegistry with register, remove by id, get by id and list with a filter. I got stuck on whether infra and tags belong on the key side or the value side and needed the interviewer to settle it.
q: 写这类 CRUD 类之前，第一句该先定下什么？
q_en: Before coding a CRUD class like this, what should the first sentence pin down?
options: 先决定用哪个第三方库来做属性过滤，避免自己写匹配逻辑
先把四个方法的函数签名和返回类型全部写出来
先设计一套索引结构，让 list(filter) 也能做到 O(1)
先定 key = agent_id、value = 完整 dict
options_en: Pick a third-party library for attribute filtering so the matching logic is not hand-written.
Write out all four method signatures and return types first.
Design an index structure so that the filtered list is also constant time.
Fix the key as the agent id and the value as the whole dict.
tradeoff: 单一主键索引 vs 多字段索引：只按 id 建索引让写路径简单、list 退化成 O(n) 扫描；多字段索引让过滤变快，代价是每次写都要维护多份索引。
why: 先说出访问模式，数据结构就自己浮现：get/remove 按 id 且要 O(1) → dict；list 带任意字段过滤 → 遍历所有 value 逐个匹配。我当天跳过这一步才纠结了半天。
why_en: State the access pattern first and the structure follows: constant-time lookup by id means a dict, and filtering on arbitrary fields means scanning the values.
whenOtherWins: 如果 list(filter) 变成最热的调用、且过滤字段只有固定那两三个，那就该为这些字段各建一个倒排索引，用写放大换读速度。
optionMeanings: 把结构选择外包给依赖。
从接口形状入手，不谈访问模式。
先追求全接口的最优复杂度。
先定主键和值的形状，再由复杂度反推容器。
optionMeanings_en: Outsources the structural choice to a dependency.
Starts from interface shape without naming access patterns.
Chases optimal complexity for every method up front.
Fixes the key and value shapes, then lets the cost target pick the container.
optionDirectness: 错在层次：面试考的就是你自己怎么选结构。
签名写完仍然不知道 key 里放什么，纠结照旧。
错在时机：n 很小时维护多份索引是净亏。
访问模式一说完，dict 加遍历的方案就定了。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong layer: choosing the structure yourself is the point of the exercise.
Signatures written and the key contents are still undecided, so the stall repeats.
Wrong timing: with a small n, maintaining extra indexes is a net loss.
Once the access pattern is stated, a dict plus a scan is settled.
optionScenarioImpacts: 在没有网络的 CoderPad 里根本用不了。
这正是我当天的顺序，结果卡在 key 侧放什么。
把 15 分钟的题做成了索引设计题。
register 和 remove 能立刻写完，时间留给 list。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: In an offline CoderPad session it is not even available.
That was my order on the day and I stalled on what goes in the key.
It turns a fifteen-minute exercise into an index design problem.
Register and remove get written immediately, leaving time for list.

termDefinitions.meaning: 访问模式：系统实际会怎么读写数据——按什么查、多频繁、要多快。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An access pattern describes how the system actually reads and writes data: by what key, how often, and how fast it must be.

termDefinitions.meaning: 倒排索引：从属性值反查到对象 id 的映射，用写入成本换查询速度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inverted index maps attribute values back to object ids, trading write cost for query speed.
